channel.title: Women's Wear Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Women's Wear Daily (wwd.com)

item.title: Celine Fall 2026: ‘We Like Bite in a Look’
item.description: Michael Rider paraded familiar, sober and sometimes austere classics - but sharpened or disrupted them to feel "fresh" and "kicky."

item.title: Vaillant Fall 2026: Dance With Me
item.description: Alice Vaillant created an ode to 1920s Paris where ballet dancers rubbed shoulders with archetypes of the city.

item.title: Comme des Garçons Fall 2026: Back in Black
item.description: With lace, sequins, chiffon and satin, Rei Kawakubo unleashed a romantic, unapologetically pretty collection.

item.title: Chappell Roan Gives Vivienne Westwood’s Boudoir Mood a Cheeky Twist in Paris
item.description: She arrived at Saturday’s fall 2026 show in a look with a plunging ruffled bodice, panniered skirt and exposed back.

item.title: Hermès Fall 2026: Nocturnal Creatures
item.description: Models streamed out of the backstage and around the twisty catwalk wearing sporty clothing meant for an evening of outdoor exploration.

item.title: Jenny Packham Fall 2026: Starry, Starry Night
item.description: Packham described the collection as "clean, crisp" and inspired by the colors and imagined textures of outer space.

item.title: Barbara Palvin Brings the Python Heel Trend to Elie Saab in Paris
item.description: The model paired the ankle-strap sandals with the label's snakeskin trench and sheer black tights.

item.title: Elizabeth Olsen Returns to Givenchy’s Boudoir Bow Mules for Paris Fashion Week
item.description: The actress wore the Sarah Burton design again at the label’s fall 2026 show, paired with a boxy blazer and leather joggers.

item.title: Paris Jackson Leans Into Power Clashing With Textured Slouch Boots at Vivienne Westwood
item.description: The black high-shaft pair cut through a layered, print-heavy look at the label’s fall 2026 show in Paris.

item.title: Duck Head Relaunching Denim Division With Two Models of Jeans
item.description: The division of Oxford Industries has been expanding beyond chinos into other categories, including golf and soft tailoring.
